name: Pylon
description: Support and Helpdesk: B2B support platform unifying Slack, Teams, email and chat into one ticketing system with AI agents.
access_notes: No self-serve free trial or free plan; access is via a sales-led 'Book a demo' flow (usepylon.com/get-started). Once a customer, Admin users generate API bearer tokens self-serve in Settings > API Tokens; the MCP server uses per-user OAuth 2.0 (AuthKit) and needs the 'MCP Access' role.
mcp_notes: Official hosted Pylon MCP Server at https://mcp.usepylon.com (streamable HTTP, OAuth 2.0 only — no API-key auth), enabled from Settings > AI Controls > MCP Server; tools for issues, accounts, contacts. No Composio Pylon toolkit found (composio.dev/toolkits/pylon returns 404).
uncertainty_notes: One pricing aggregator (pricingpagehub.com) claims a free trial exists, but the official site only offers a demo form and multiple independent reviews state there is no self-serve trial; recorded as contact_sales. OAuth applies to the MCP server (per-user), not the REST API, which is bearer-token only.

evidence.note: 'The Pylon API uses Bearer authentication'; API tokens generated in the Pylon dashboard (Settings > API Tokens).

Only Admin users can create API tokens; API covers accounts, contacts, issues, messages, tasks, knowledge base, custom objects etc.; webhooks configured via Settings > Webhooks and Triggers with 'Send webhook' actions.
Official Pylon MCP Server at https://mcp.usepylon.com, OAuth 2.0 (AuthKit), streamable HTTP, read/write tools for issues, accounts, contacts, scoped to the user's dashboard permissions.
Official get-started page is a 'Schedule a personalized 30-minute demo' form; no self-serve signup path.
Official developer docs: REST API at api.usepylon.com with a full API reference across Pylon objects.
